correctness.rationale: Projective chart count R=Σ(h+1)q^h; character scaling W=1−R+qZ. All but four charts contribute q-divisible zero counts; the four remaining contribute 1 modulo q. Thus W≡−q (mod q²) for all frequencies n≥4. For n=2,3 direct chart formulas give exact zeros. Full exact finite checks over GF2, GF3, GF5, GF7, GF4 agree; no computation replaces the infinite proof.
